top.description: Player 1 background (Mario + Luigi). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
top.prompt: A beautiful modern 2D digital illustration, square format 1:1. A single continuous, seamless, and unified landscape of the Mushroom Kingdom showing lush green grassy hills under a clear blue sky, spanning the entire width. On the left side of this same landscape, Mario (red cap, blue overalls) leaps dynamically with one arm raised in his victory jump. On the right side of this same landscape, Luigi (green cap, blue overalls) stands waving. Both characters are naturally integrated into the same single-picture scenery and are drawn slightly smaller to fit entirely within the frame with a safe margin from the outer edges. The center of the grassy hills is empty and clean. No split screen, no vertical dividers, no black bars, no empty black columns, no black panels. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, cropped characters, split screen, black bars, vertical dividers, black columns, black panels

bottom.description: Player 2 background (Bowser + torre). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
bottom.prompt: A dramatic modern 2D digital illustration, square format 1:1. A single continuous, seamless, and unified volcanic landscape showing a wide stone bridge over a glowing river of orange lava under a dark volcanic sky, spanning the entire width. On the left side of this same bridge stands Bowser, a massive green-shelled spike monster roaring and breathing small orange flames. On the right side of this same bridge stands a dark stone fortress tower with glowing lava cracks. Both elements are naturally integrated into the same single-picture scenery and are drawn slightly smaller to fit entirely within the frame with a safe margin from the outer edges. The center of the stone bridge is empty and clean. No split screen, no vertical dividers, no black bars, no empty black columns, no black panels. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, cropped characters, split screen, black bars, vertical dividers, black columns, black panels

loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Mario y Bowser jugando a MTG de forma cómica. Estilo ilustración digital 2D suave.
loader.prompt: A humorous modern 2D cartoon illustration of a card match in the classic Super Mario style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Mario and Bowser are seated properly and facing each other across a table made of green warp pipes and brick blocks, playing a game of Magic. Mario has a highly concentrated, funny expression holding his cards, while Bowser looks frustrated trying to pick up a tiny card with his large claws. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table, a detailed Magic: The Gathering card layout is displayed: rows of fantasy cards with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degrees to indicate they are tapped, next to a red Super Mushroom and a green 1-Up Mushroom. Peach's Castle visible through a window in the background. Smooth vector outlines, polished cel-shading. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
